content.value_statement: A page needs fetchability and listing evidence before its citation potential can be assessed. This skill organizes a single-URL checklist covering status, robots, sitemap, and scoring validation.
actual_capabilities: Focus the review on one named URL.
Organize status, robots, and sitemap observations in a draft.
Provide an ordered checklist for recording indexability evidence.
Direct a scoring attempt using a referenced Python script.
Require revisiting the recorded evidence when scoring fails.
Use a zero script exit status as the checklist completion condition.
limitations: The referenced scoring script is not included in the supplied skill.
The draft format and scoring criteria are not defined.
No automated fetching, robots analysis, or sitemap inspection is included.
The checklist does not provide a site grade or guarantee indexing, ranking, or citation.

use_cases.title: Document a Page Review
use_cases.description: Record status, robots, and sitemap evidence for one page before assessing its search visibility.

use_cases.title: Review a Deployment
use_cases.description: Organize indexability observations for a newly deployed URL and revisit the draft when validation fails.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Publication Review
use_cases.description: Collect fetchability and listing evidence for one published article before discussing its citation potential.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the indexability checklist for [URL]. Leave missing status, robots, and sitemap evidence incomplete.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: organize a first single-URL review.

prompt_templates.title: Record Supplied Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Record these observations for [URL]: [status], [robots evidence], and [sitemap evidence]. Mark missing information without inferring a pass.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a draft from collected observations.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Scoring Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my draft for [URL]: [draft]. Identify missing observations. Check whether the referenced scoring script is available and reviewed before proposing execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: assess readiness for the scoring step.

prompt_templates.title: Revisit a Failed Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: For [URL], review this draft and scoring failure: [draft and failure]. Revisit status, robots, and sitemap evidence. Keep completion pending without successful validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: revise recorded evidence after a failed scoring attempt.

output_examples.input: Start a review for a supplied article URL without any observations.
output: Scoring: pending; the referenced script must be available and reviewed.

output_examples.input: I recorded status 200, no blocking robots directive, and sitemap inclusion. The scoring script is unavailable.
output: Validation: incomplete because the referenced scoring script is unavailable.
Conclusion: observations recorded; no validated indexability pass or indexing guarantee.

best_practices: Keep each review limited to one clearly identified URL.
Record observed status, robots, and sitemap evidence without inventing missing results.
Review the scoring script and confirm its location before running it.
anti_patterns: Treating one URL's checklist as a site-wide grade.
Claiming validation succeeded when the scoring script was unavailable or failed.
Running an unrelated local script solely because its path matches the checklist.

faq.question: What does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It organizes a single-URL indexability review using status, robots, sitemap evidence, and a referenced scoring step.

faq.question: Does it inspect pages automatically?
faq.answer: No fetching or inspection implementation is included. Supply observations or use separately available tools to collect them.

faq.question: Is the scoring script included?
faq.answer: No. The supplied skill contains only the checklist. Obtain and review the referenced script before executing it.

faq.question: What happens when scoring fails?
faq.answer: The checklist directs you back to the evidence-recording step and requires another scoring attempt.

faq.question: Does a completed checklist guarantee search indexing or AI citation?
faq.answer: No. It records an indexability pass for one URL, not a site grade, ranking prediction, or citation guarantee.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The report lists all three tools. The scoring step additionally requires Python and the separately available scoring script.
